decisions.statement: The account the operations belong to is handed in rather than read from a client here.
The enrolment is found by the account the enrolment names.
The report is held under one property as JSON text.
Text already held under that property is read back as JSON before merging.
The moment reported is handed in rather than read from the clock here.
The version reported is the version the watcher names.
An entry held under no name is dropped rather than merged in.
No account signed in leaves the enrolment unchanged.
No enrolment page for the account is logged rather than raised.
No failure here reaches the caller.
Nothing here reads or writes a file.

definition: one run's operations merged into the watcher enrolment page for the signed-in account
